author: Wonsik Choi

carrier_and_background.scope: Finite homogeneous constitutive completion, with inherited conditional local renderer
carrier_and_background.ownership: Energy-volume exponents, operators and information clock are declared constitutive choices

calibration_and_local_source.response_provenance: Calibrated constitutive input adopted in WRRA Galactic Disk paper v1.0 2026-09-27
calibration_and_local_source.gravity_ontology: B_C continuous geometric branch; no independent gravitational Hilbert space
calibration_and_local_source.lensing_condition: Phi = Psi assumed in the finite weak-field patch
calibration_and_local_source.fraction_note: Editable late-universe energy-weighted calibration; not counts of bits or particle channels

definition_policy.Actual: complete current modeled state and its total weighted load
definition_policy.quantization: future actual operation producing discrete phenotype and physical record; not yet executed
definition_policy.phenotype: currently expressed sector budget, adopted from inherited calibrated branch
definition_policy.residue: retained unexpressed state content; no extra independent sector
definition_policy.record: future physical outcome record; distinct from software provenance

ledger_0_7.fraction_provenance: Inherited rounded late-universe reference: 0.0493 phenotype and 0.265 clustering; remaining background is calculated. Information-to-energy identification is a WRRA constitutive choice.

filter_calibration.tag_provenance: Calibrated origin-to-weak-component orientation preserving the 0.2 known-particle branch; signs are inputs, not a microscopic discovery.
filter_calibration.neutral_channel_status: Transported gauge-neutral extension interpreted as nu_R^c; its particle existence, mass and occupation are not measured by this release.
filter_calibration.response_shift_scope: Dimensionless lower-order readout calibration. Not a rest-mass value or an extra SI energy sector.

physical_baseline.PDG_charge_convention: PDG Q=T3+Y_PDG/2; this release uses Y=Y_PDG/2 and Q=T3+Y.

input_ledger.scope: Calibrated selection within the fixed four-filter family; three-generation charge inventory with conditional neutral extensions; no mass/mixing derivation or physical quantization event.

family_replication.provenance: Three observed Standard-Model generations adopted as calibration; replication count is not derived here.
